title: US credit card
description: One US credit card: identity, annual fee and every recurring benefit (statement credits and perks).

id.description: Stable id: <issuer-short>-<card-slug>, e.g. "amex-gold". Never reuse or rename once published.

name.description: Card name without the issuer and without ®/™, e.g. "Gold", "Sapphire Reserve".

currency.description: Rewards currency code, e.g. USD (cash back), AMERICAN_EXPRESS (MR), CHASE (UR), CITI (TYP), DELTA, MARRIOTT, HILTON…

discontinued.description: Closed to new applicants (existing cardholders may keep benefits).

imageUrl.description: Card art image (issuer-hosted or licensed). Optional.

signupBonus.description: Current public welcome offer. Optional — offers change often; include asOf.

amount.description: Points/miles, or USD for cash-back cards.

legacyIds.description: Ids this card had in other catalogs (e.g. andenacitelli/credit-card-bonuses-api cardId) — lets apps migrate references.

lastVerified.description: YYYY-MM-DD the benefit list was last checked against the issuer's own benefits page.

sources.description: Issuer benefit pages (preferred) or reputable references used to verify this file.

benefits.description: EVERY recurring benefit of the card, whether or not you personally use it (empty array if the card has none). Apps let users untick what they don't want.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, unique within the card.

name.description: Short display name, e.g. "Uber Cash", "Resy credit".

type.description: credit = dollar statement credit (value required); perk = non-cash benefit, optionally valued (lounge access, free night).

value.description: USD value PER PERIOD (e.g. 15 for a $15/month credit). null = unvalued perk.

intervalMonths.description: Required when frequency is custom, e.g. 48 for a Global Entry credit every 4 years.

alignment.description: calendar = resets on Jan 1 / quarter / month boundaries; anniversary = resets on the cardmember year.

inApp.description: Applied inside a partner app/portal (Uber Cash, DashPass, Lyft, issuer travel portal) — no statement credit posts, so it can't be auto-matched.

matchKeywords.description: Lower-case words that appear WHOLE in the statement-credit line (merchant/name/description). Prefer the most specific word(s); generic words (credit, fee, annual, amex, chase…) are ignored by matchers. Empty for inApp credits and perks.

matchVerified.description: true only if the keywords were seen on a real posted statement credit (add it to descriptorExamples).

descriptorExamples.description: Real statement-credit descriptors seen for this benefit, e.g. "AMEX RESY CREDIT".

notes.description: Caveats: variable amounts ("$35 in December"), split periods, exclusions.

endDate.description: Last day of a limited-time benefit, if announced.
